summary: ADR-0058 accepted 2026-08-18; persisted Acceptance runs, action DAGs, events, command registries, route projections, and receipts are authoritative evidence; requests identify only target plan and prepared run input; caller route/lifecycle claims lack authority; action results bind run, event, registry, candidate, contract, Knowledge, Skill-input, and validator identities; v2 request data is historical-only; Bootstrap ownership and automatic startup remain excluded; replayable/reentrant coordination; caller-complete graphs, mismatched receipts, and unregistered actions rejected; Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed; no release or commit authority
